how: We read the website of every Philadelphia wedding planner listed on Lazo (159 listings, 123 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues, DJ companies and a salon that showed up under planning, a photo and video studio that also sells planning, a duplicate listing, and a site that was only a menu. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Which Philadelphia and Main Line venues have you run a wedding at this year, and do you know their load-in, parking and noise rules?
Full planning, partial, or day-of? Ask what each tier includes in meetings, hours and vendor management.
Who is actually on site on my wedding day, you or an associate, and how many weddings do you take per weekend?

picks.name: Truly You Events
picks.blurb: Christiane Lehman runs Truly You Events as a boutique Philadelphia planning firm, with fifteen years of wedding planning, a business degree and a planning certification behind her. The site lays out three tiers of service, all with consulting support and in-person meetings, and her work has run in Philadelphia Wedding Magazine.

picks.name: The Wedding Planner
picks.blurb: Gina Sole danced 14 years with the Pennsylvania Ballet, earned a fine arts degree from Moore College of Art and Design, and apprenticed with Vera Wang in New York before planning weddings. The Wedding Planner offers full-service and day-of coordination plus consulting for couples on other budgets.

picks.name: Musa Weddings
picks.blurb: Musa Weddings is a Jenkintown planning and design studio for couples who want clear leadership and creative direction, producing what it calls experiences rather than events. Working in Philadelphia and select destinations since 2017.

picks.name: Elegant Events Planning + Design
picks.blurb: Elegant Events Planning + Design plans Indian and multicultural weddings across South Jersey and Philadelphia with an in-house team of planners, designers and creatives. The firm's motto is that everything be done decently and in order, and it belongs to the Association of Bridal Consultants.

picks.name: Prestige Event Design
picks.blurb: Kady of Prestige Event Design plans luxury weddings across Philadelphia, Delaware and New Jersey, and the site notes her work as an African wedding planner has been featured in Philadelphia Wedding Magazine, Black Bride and WeddingWire. She is a member of the Bridal Suite Wedding Collective by Black Bride.

picks.name: Main Line Wedding Planner
picks.blurb: Jeff of Main Line Wedding Planner has managed events for nearly 30 years and knows more than 100 of the region's venues, having worked in floral, tents and rentals, hotels and catering along the way. The Merion Station firm says it rarely overlaps events so each client gets a high-touch process.

picks.name: Events by AFG
picks.blurb: Alison Goldberg's Events by AFG is built around the morning of the wedding: when you hire her, vendors stop calling you and the hiccups get handled. She acts as the vendor contact, checks details and decor, and manages logistics once your own planning is done.

picks.name: Kaleidoscope Weddings
picks.blurb: Kaleidoscope Weddings brings a team to every wedding and asks couples to pick the custom category that fits their level of luxury and needs. The Philadelphia firm's pitch is simple: available, committed, professional, and planners who chose this as a career.

picks.name: Tulip Hill Weddings
picks.blurb: Luanne of Tulip Hill Weddings started at age eight as an assistant to her family's wedding business and draws on a lifetime in the industry. Her approach is to pull each couple's uniqueness into the design, and she stays from engagement through the wedding day on vision, budget and vendor recommendations.

picks.name: BMarie Wedding Planning
picks.blurb: Brittany founded BMarie Wedding Planning after nine years as an emergency department nurse, and still works the ER by night. Full-service wedding and event coordination for Delaware, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, with packages customized rather than fixed because no two events are the same.

picks.name: Heaven Sent Wedding Consultants & Travel Agency
picks.blurb: Christina Maddox runs Heaven Sent as a Delaware wedding planner, floral designer and international travel agency in one, and serves as Delaware State Director for the Association of Bridal Consultants. She has screened vendors and sites across Pennsylvania, Delaware and New Jersey.

picks.name: Burke & Poppy
picks.blurb: Raya Lambert of Burke & Poppy is the lead planner, floral designer and stylist in one studio, which she calls being an industry disrupter. Based in Lancaster with partial and full planning available across Pennsylvania, and an event venue of its own.
